items.label: Capture Project Control, terminology, Editor owner, and old roadmap context before implementation.
items.evidenceTarget: Project Control entrypoint, Work path, owner repository, active role, current phase, checklist target, evidence target, terminology docs, Editor AGENTS.md, and old roadmap Task 11 are identified before editing.
items.verificationNote: Identified Work path flowdoc-product-development-resumption > flowdoc-core-backend-editor-readiness-pass-8h, owner repository repo-editor, Project Control record owner repo-project-control, phase target phase-flowdoc-core-backend-editor-readiness-pass-editor-wysiwyg-gate-definition, checklist target checklist-flowdoc-core-backend-editor-readiness-pass-editor-wysiwyg-gate-definition, and evidence target evidence-editor-wysiwyg-gate-definition-2026-08-31.

items.label: Write failing WYSIWYG gate tests before accepting the definition.
items.evidenceTarget: The focused Editor WYSIWYG gate test fails before the spec and exported gate decision exist.
items.verificationNote: RED evidence included npm run test -- src/tests/wysiwygGate.test.ts failing because docs/superpowers/specs/2026-08-30-editor-wysiwyg-gate-design.md did not exist and the WYSIWYG gate exports were undefined.

items.label: Define what FlowDoc WYSIWYG means and what is out of scope.
items.evidenceTarget: The spec defines FlowDoc WYSIWYG as managed document-surface authoring and separates it from textarea fallback, Overview, History, Structure, and Preview.
items.verificationNote: The spec states FlowDoc WYSIWYG means managed document-surface authoring, keeps Hybrid Managed Cards + one Active Text-Block Island as the accepted direction, and states that the bounded textarea active text-block island is not WYSIWYG.

items.label: Add an Editor-owned WYSIWYG gate decision to the text-block authoring boundary.
items.evidenceTarget: The boundary exports WYSIWYG behavior categories, non-WYSIWYG behaviors, required prerequisites, and a decision function.
items.verificationNote: resolveWysiwygGateDecision reports canStartWysiwyg false until every prerequisite is approved and keeps the activeTextInputBinding value as textarea.

items.label: Keep contenteditable and common rich editor engines blocked.
items.evidenceTarget: Tests prove contenteditable remains blocked and package metadata does not include Slate, ProseMirror, or TipTap.
items.verificationNote: wysiwygGate.test.ts blocks contenteditable, slate, prosemirror-state, and @tiptap/core at the gate. boundary.test.ts also keeps blocked editor dependencies out of package metadata and source.

items.label: Verify focused gates, full Editor worktree gate, and merged Editor main gate.
items.evidenceTarget: Focused WYSIWYG and boundary tests pass, Editor worktree npm run check passes, and merged Editor main npm run check passes.
items.verificationNote: Editor passed npm run test -- src/tests/wysiwygGate.test.ts src/tests/textBlockAuthoringBoundary.test.ts with 2 files and 7 tests, then passed a related 5-file gate with 23 tests. Editor worktree and merged main both passed npm run check with 109 test files, 395 tests, and build.

items.label: Record the bounded WYSIWYG gate definition in Project Control without promoting readiness.
items.evidenceTarget: Project Control records the phase, checklist, and evidence target for the WYSIWYG gate definition while preserving readiness and map-truth boundaries.
items.verificationNote: Project Control record tests require the phase, checklist, evidence, Editor merge commit, FlowDoc WYSIWYG definition wording, bounded textarea non-WYSIWYG wording, 395-test verification, and WYSIWYG nonactivation statement before the record can pass. The Project Control worktree passed the focused roadmap test with 1 file and 2 tests. The combined npm run check repeated the known Vitest fork worker timeout in app-jsdom, so the worktree used the split gate: check:data, type-check, node Vitest 52 files with 276 tests, app-jsdom Vitest 7 files with 54 tests, build, and 6 Playwright e2e tests.
